title: Noise-Robust Forced Alignment for Spontaneous Speech
abstract: arXiv:2610.22583v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We show that forced aligners degrade on spontaneous, noisy real-world speech, and that fillers, laughter, and disfluencies corrupt word boundaries, impacting many downstream applications. We revisit the classical GMM-HMM aligner with upsampled WavLM features instead of MFCCs, explicit phone units for fillers and non-lexical vocal events trained on verbatim-annotated spontaneous speech, and a discriminative projection fitted on clean and noise-corrupted feature pairs to improve robustness. The pipeline is self-bootstrapped from 149h of curated audio without manual or external boundary targets. On conversational (Buckeye) and disfluent (FluencyBank) speech it reaches word-boundary MAEs of 20.6 and 76.9ms, 19% and 17% lower than the strongest of ten baselines. Catastrophic misalignments (>200ms) are 2.7 times rarer than Montreal Forced Aligners (MFA) best model even after widening MFA's search beam, which we show removes a large pruning art

translated_title: 面向自发语音的抗噪声强制对齐
translated_abstract: 我们证明强制对齐器在自发、嘈杂的真实世界语音上性能会退化，填充词、笑声和不流畅现象会破坏词边界，影响许多下游应用。我们重新审视了经典的GMM-HMM对齐器，采用上采样的WavLM特征代替MFCC，使用在逐字标注的自发语音上训练的、针对填充词和非词汇声音事件的显式音素单元，并通过在干净与噪声污染特征对上拟合的判别投影来提高鲁棒性。该流程从149小时的精选音频中自举训练，无需人工或外部边界目标。在会话语音（Buckeye）和不流畅语音（FluencyBank）上，其词边界平均绝对误差（MAE）分别达到20.6和76.9毫秒，比十个基线中最强者的结果分别低19%和17%。即使在扩大MFA搜索束之后（我们表明这会消除一个较大的剪枝伪影），其灾难性错位（>200毫秒）也比蒙特利尔强制对齐器（MFA）最佳模型少2.7倍。
tldr: 本文提出一种面向自发嘈杂语音的抗噪声强制对齐方法，通过上采样WavLM特征、为填充词和非词汇声音事件设置显式音素单元以及判别投影，将词边界误差较最强基线降低17%-19%，灾难性错位比MFA最佳模型减少2.7倍。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a noise-robust forced alignment method for spontaneous speech using upsampled WavLM features, explicit phone units for fillers and non-lexical vocal events, and a discriminative projection, reducing word-boundary errors by 17-19% over the strongest baselines with 2.7x fewer catastrophic misalignments than MFA's best model.
